title: A resolution informing the House of Representatives that a quorum of the Senate is assembled.
latestAction: Message on Senate action sent to the House.
summary: This resolution directs the Secretary of the Senate to inform the House of Representatives that a quorum of the Senate is assembled and that the Senate is ready to proceed to business.

actions.text: Message on Senate action sent to the House.
